messages:
alex: CI red on runtime tests — intermittent failure in TestSharedCacheConcurrency on linux-x86 matrix. Failing branch: feature/prefetch-locks.

ci-bot: CI build #12045 red. failing test: runtime/serve/tests/test_shared_cache.py::TestSharedCacheConcurrency::test_race_on_insert. See artifacts: http://ci.internal/12045/artifacts

devon: I hit this locally earlier — reproduces sporadically with stress-run --jobs=8. Stack shows assertion in cache.size after concurrent inserts, looks like an off-by-one in accounting under contention.

maya: Can someone grab a bisect? My hunch is the eviction-order reorder in PR #842 changed timings.

alex: I'll kick a rerun on the failing job. Also pasting the failure tail: ```
AssertionError: expected 64, got 63
  at runtime::cache::tests::test_shared_cache::TestSharedCacheConcurrency::test_race_on_insert
  at tests/common.rs:142
```

linh: Quick idea — I added lightweight thread tagging and an insert-order log in a debug build. Can push a CI debug variant to print thread ids around insert/evict.

devon: If it's nondet we should sweep seeds. @alex can you add --seed=${SEED} output and rerun a stress matrix (like 20-50 runs)? That will tell us frequency.

alex: @ci-bot please rerun matrix job 12045 with env TEST_STRESS_RUNS=50 TEST_RANDOM_SEED=${BUILD_ID}

ci-bot: Rerun requested: job 12045.2 queued. ETA ~12m.

maya: Also try a binary check: disable prefetch (optimize-prefetch=false) in the job. If failure stops, prefetch+eviction interaction is likely.

devon: For bisecting, start range: commit 6a1f2 (before eviction re-order) -> 8b2d9 (after). I can run `git bisect run` locally if you mark known-good/bad.

alex: I can run a quick git bisect tomorrow morning. Meanwhile, let's get multiple reruns to estimate flakiness; don't want to block the release yet.

linh: I'll push a debug-only PR that prints insert timestamps + thread id; will tag here once CI fires. Also pinging @devops to allocate a bigger worker if we need >8 parallel jobs.

maya: :thumbsup: keeping updates here. If bisect points to PR #842, we'll open a revert/hotfix with minimal change.

devon: Thanks — leaving my local reproducer link: https://internal/repos/runtime/tests/repro-shared-cache.sh (Docker based). Use `./repro-shared-cache.sh --jobs 12 --runs 100` to stress.

alex: OK, marking this as P1 for triage until we know frequency. Will post bisect results and debug-PR link in this thread.
